{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''John Irwin Hutchinson''' (12 April 1867 – 1 December 1935) was an [[Americans|American]] [[mathematician]] born in [[Bangor, Maine]]. He was educated at [[Bates College]], (A.B., 1889), [[Clark University]] (1890–92), and the [[University of Chicago]] (Ph.D., 1896).<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=5696}}</ref> With [[Virgil Snyder]] he was coauthor of ''Differential and Integral Calculus'' (1902) and ''Elementary Treatise on the Calculus'' (1912).

== Books ==
* [https://archive.org/details/diffintegralcalc00snydrich Differential and integral calculus] (New York, American Book Company, 1902) 
* [https://resolver.library.cornell.edu/math/1927725 Elementary textbook on the calculus.] (New York, American Book Company, 1912)
